sourceReview.reason: Rechecked 2026-11-15 against full Nov 10 TheStreet report (https://www.thestreet.com/crypto/markets/binances-bstocks-leads-4-8b-tokenized-stock-market-with-31-share), which attributes about $4.8bn on Nov 10 to Token Terminal but does not establish $4.81bn or 9.1x on Nov 14. Castle Labs' dated Nov 14 CoinGecko-based analysis (https://castlelabs.io/research/tokenized-stocks) reports $2.84bn across 1,664 tokens, illustrating materially different dataset coverage. No dated full original Token Terminal dataset or comparable independent full-text corroboration of the exact $4.81bn and 9.1x measurement was found. No three-fact verified ledger; keep held and retry no sooner than 2026-11-15T20:14:22Z.
